The fix added 「其中 {backward} 次是逆向的」 directly after that sentence, so 其中 now has the premises as its antecedent, not the 497 uses. verdicts.where: connections.zh.svg <desc>: 「承接 189 条而另有说法」 / 「105 条本论没有承接」 against the strip's 「189 改变 · … · 105 未承继」
verdicts.why: The finding is real but narrow. The zh mirrors the English desc faithfully, since the English also says "takes up 189 to say otherwise" and "105 it does not take up" against a strip that says "not carried". In Chinese, though, 承接 and 承继 are near-synonyms, so the 105 get two names and the 189 can read as carried. Using the strip's words (改变 / 未承继) is the right small fix. Low.
